summary: Example group_vars/netvisor.yml with network_cli, the netvisor network_os, user, vaulted password and optional proxy command.
questions: What group_vars do I need for Pluribus Netvisor?

answer_card.title: NETVISOR group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: community.netcommon.netvisor
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
(Value shown as in this page's example.) Drop `ansible_password` with SSH keys and the proxy line for direct access.
